question: Find the total surface area of a solid right circular cylinder whose radius and height are 7 cm and 12 cm, respectively. (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 7 cm

Height (h) = 12 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cylinder = 2πr² + 2πrh

**Calculation:**

TSA = 2πr² + 2πrh

Substitute the given values:

TSA = 2 × (22/7) × (7)² + 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 12

TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 49 + 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 12

TSA = (22/7) × 98 + (22/7) × 168

TSA = (22 × 98)/7 + (22 × 168)/7

TSA = (2156)/7 + (3696)/7

TSA = (2156 + 3696)/7

TSA = 5852/7

TSA = 835.71 cm²

**∴ The total surface area of the cylinder is 836 cm².**
